summary: T1 item 1 (design sources): design/opamp_core.sch is the committed schematic source and design/netlist/opamp_core.spice is the xschem-generated netlist derived from it. The cited input, opamp_core.pair.json, pins the sha256 of both files. CI (.github/workflows/design-sources.yml) re-runs headless xschem on the schematic with design/xschemrc and fails when the regenerated netlist differs from the committed one (design/bin/netlist_check.py; normalised: sch_path line, wrapping, number formatting, xschem-version-dependent evaluation of the PDK symbols' derived ad/as/pd/ps/nrd/nrs formulas, compared within 0.5 %), or when the pair record is stale. Negative controls: design/bin/test_netlist_check.py. LIMITS: klt signoff grades this generic envelope on its status field and never re-hashes the cited input (klayout-tools#2196, #2403); the repo-side re-hash step in .github/workflows/signoff.yml and the design-sources workflow are what keep it honest. It asserts nothing about sizing, spec compliance, or the PDK-symbol library beyond the pin in sim/gm-id-characterization/pdk.json.
